name: SD: An emergency department under pressure (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: An emergency department's patients waiting, patients treated and under observation, staff on shift and staff fatigue, counted every hour. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-emergency/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests effects: treatment speeds up with more staff and slows down when the waiting room is crowded (two effects on one flow), and tired staff make more mistakes that send patients back.
